title: No one will know
caption:
"I'll just skip it today. No one will know."

You'll know. And that quiet little knowing chips away at the trust you have in yourself, one skipped day at a time.

What's the thing you keep telling yourself doesn't count?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: Do it, book it or park it
caption:
This one's for the creative brains. The ones who can think of a hundred things at once, then end up on the sofa doing none of them.

I had a run of fantastic projects recently. By all logic I should have been buzzing. Instead I felt heavy, because every commitment I didn't show up for added a bit more weight.

So I gave myself one simple rule: do it, book it or park it.

Five minutes or less? Do it now. Needs proper time? Book it in, there and then. Not for now? Park it, properly, and stop carrying it around.

What's one thing you could do, book or park today?

Let's Do This!

title: Your comfort zone isn't comfortable
caption:
Your comfort zone isn't actually comfortable. It's familiar.

Your brain will pick the known over the better almost every time, simply because it knows the shape of it.

Where are you choosing familiar over what you actually want?

title: Isn't this selfish
caption:
"Stuart, isn't it a bit selfish, focusing on me?"

I hear this a lot. If you're not looking after yourself, the bucket you give from is emptying faster than it's filling. Full stop.

When did you last top yours up?

title: Your brain wasn't built for meaning
caption:
Your brain's job isn't to help you find a meaningful life. Its job is to keep you safe, so whatever feels urgent will always win.

Meaning is something you have to choose on purpose.

What keeps winning the urgency battle in your week?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

title: Motivation vs momentum
caption:
Motivation is something you experience. Momentum is something you influence.

Stop waiting to feel like it and start building the thing you can actually move.

What's one small push you could give something today?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: Why we avoid difficult conversations
caption:
Why do you keep avoiding the conversation you know you need to have?

Worried about the reaction, the relationship, how you'll come across. We all do it, and there's always a reason.

Which conversation have you been putting off?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: You're not who you were
caption:
You're not the same person you were in your twenties. Or your thirties. Or last year.

We're always shifting. So wouldn't it be useful to have a say in who you're becoming?

What's changed most in you over the last ten years?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: Stop taking huge steps
caption:
"I've got so much to do, so I need to take huge steps."

That's exactly why you're exhausted. Small, steady steps beat giant leaps you can't keep up, and imperfect progress beats perfect procrastination.

What's the smallest next step on your biggest thing?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: A perfectly broken system
caption:
A perfectly broken system gives you perfect results every time. They just won't be the results you want.

At some point it's worth falling out of love with the process and looking honestly at what it's giving you.

What result keeps repeating in your life?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: Not yours to hold
caption:
Not everything you're carrying is yours to hold.

Some of it still matters to you. That doesn't mean it's yours to carry.

What could you put down this week?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: Who drains you
caption:
If you leave time with someone and feel drained, pay attention to that.

It doesn't mean ending the friendship. It means going in better prepared.

Who leaves you feeling lighter?

title: The myth of being ready
caption:
"I just need one more thing before I start."

The myth of being ready. Momentum doesn't turn up before you start. It turns up because you did.

What are you waiting to feel ready for?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

title: One conversation
caption:
You could carry something for years and it might take one conversation to clear it.

Not guaranteed. But it could.

Is there one you've been carrying?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

title: Identity is built
caption:
Identity isn't something you find in a Christmas cracker one morning. It's built, and you're the one building it.

What would you like to build next?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

title: There are no five steps
caption:
Everyone and their golden retriever has five steps to save your life.

There are no five steps to anything. There's what works for you, in the context of your own life.

What's a piece of advice that just didn't fit you?

title: The Mount Everest problem
caption:
When a problem feels the size of Mount Everest, we assume the fix must be just as big.

It rarely is. The problem is usually lots of little things, and so is the way through.

What's your Everest at the moment?

Let's Do This!

title: You don't need to control everything
caption:
You don't need to control everything around you to live more intentionally.

Where might you be holding on too tightly?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: You don't need more hours
caption:
You don't need more hours in your day. You don't need perfect motivation. You definitely don't need to overhaul your life.

You need to see where your energy is already going.

Where did yours go this week?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: Anxiety vs fear
caption:
Anxiety is thinking there might be a sabre-tooth tiger round the corner. Fear is when it's standing in front of you.

The more evidence you have that you can handle things, the less you live braced for the tiger.

What's something you handled that you didn't think you could?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: No sword, shield or bazooka
caption:
Avoiding a difficult conversation often means changing shape to fit.

It doesn't have to be a battle. No sword, no shield, no bazooka. Just the conversation, done well, and everyone can come out better for it.

How do you usually go into the hard ones?

This is a snippet from one of my monthly masterclasses inside The Living Room. See how it works: the-living-room.com

Let's Do This!

title: A mark you'll never meet
caption:
We measure ourselves against a mark we'll never meet, then call ourselves a failure for missing it.

Better question: what am I actually expecting of myself, and is it fair?

Whose measuring stick are you using?
